name: Eric Sargiacomo - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Implementing Protocol (2024–2029) to the Fisheries Partnership Agreement between the European Community and the Republic of Guinea-Bissau
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on a new five-year fishing deal between the EU and Guinea-Bissau. It does not change the law itself. It asks the European Commission to make sure the deal helps Guinea-Bissau's own fishing communities, not just EU boats. It wants more fish landed locally, better infrastructure, fair pay for local sailors, action against illegal fishing, and clear information on how EU support money is spent.

- **What changes:** EU boats keep fishing rights; Parliament wants more local benefits and transparency.
- **Who it affects:** EU fishing fleets, Guinea-Bissau's coastal communities and authorities.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on the deal; the Commission must report back before renewal.
